entities.summary: Trevor van Riemsdyk, often known by his initials TVR, is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Washington Capitals of the National Hockey League (NHL). He won the Stanley Cup in 2015, his rookie season, with the Chicago Blackhawks and has also played for the Carolina Hurricanes.
